verses.1: And it was said, “Let him send his wife away from him. She will go away from him and become the wife of another man. Then he will return to her again, after the land has been devastated by destruction. And she will become the wife of many enemies. Please, come back to me again, O Jehovah!”
verses.2: Look with your eyes at the rivers and see where you do not sit on their banks. You sit there like a monster in the desert. You have despoiled the land under your control and made it your own.
verses.3: And many people were driven away from him; he had no one to help him. And from that woman, you became a slave. From Anath, everyone was taken away.
verses.4: From now on, my father calls me “Aluf Ne’uyar”.
verses.5: May it be that you will be punished forever, if you continue to do evil and commit wrongful acts.
verses.6: And the LORD said to me, “In the days of Josiah, the king who brought Israel back to God, she went up to all the high mountains and to beneath every tree. She gathered her crops there.”
verses.7: And he said, “After she did all these things, she should return to me. But she didn’t do so. Then she saw her sister Judith in a state of shame.”
verses.8: And I saw that over all the women who were taken captive by Israel, he would send them away, and he would give her the list of their names. But she would not be able to see any of them again. Then she would go and become a widow as well.
verses.9: And from the depth of her lust, she will destroy the land, and she will destroy the trees and the plants.
verses.10: And even in all this, Judah did not return to me in her whole heart. For it was through deceit that Jehovah spoke.
verses.11: And the LORD said to me, “Righteousness shall be in her heart, and she shall reign over Israel from among her enemies. She shall be called Jehovah.”
verses.12: You went and proclaimed these words. You said, “Israel shall return.” The LORD has spoken: “I will not abandon you forever.” My face will be with you, for I am a faithful God. The LORD says, “I will not abandon you forever.”
verses.13: But know this: In your God, who is holy, you have sinned. You have strayed from His ways, towards the idols of other gods, under all kinds of trees that bear fragrant flowers. And in my voice, you have not heard me. May the voice of Jehovah be heard!
verses.14: Come back, children who have been scattered! Let us praise the LORD, for I have taken you from one city and two families. I have brought you here as my own.
verses.15: And I will give you enemies like dogs. They will harm you with their knowledge and their cunning.
verses.16: And it shall be that in those days, when they come and settle down in this land, the LORD will say no more, “Do not break the covenant of the LORD.” They shall not do any more evil. They shall not remember it anymore, nor shall they commit any more wrongdoing.
verses.17: On that day, they will call upon Jerusalem as the place of God’s presence. All nations will come to Jerusalem in the name of God. They will not go away anymore because of the evil thoughts in their hearts.
verses.18: In those days, the House of Judah will go against the House of Israel. They will come together from the land of Canaan to the land that I gave to your ancestors.
verses.19: And I said, “How will you cultivate the land? I will give you a fertile land, a land full of crops and animals. But my father said, ‘Do not return to me.’”
verses.20: Now, a woman from her enemy’s land did this to me. So also did those who lived in the house of Israel. May the LORD have mercy on us.
verses.21: A loud cry was heard at the camps of the children of Israel, because they had forgotten their God, Jehovah.
verses.22: Come back, children who have returned! From your return, we are here for you. For you are Jehovah, our God.
verses.23: Now, from the depths of these mountains, may there be salvation for Israel in our God.
verses.24: And the serpent devoured our ancestors from their youth, taking away their wealth, their children, and their grandchildren.
verses.25: We have been covered with filth and dirt; we are completely unclean. For we have sinned against the LORD our God, both we and our ancestors since our youth, all the way up to this day. We have not listened to the voice of the LORD our God.
